nodes.label: Laravel Best Practices Skill
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Consistency first: follow existing application patterns even if suboptimal; rules are defaults for when no pattern exists, not overrides.

nodes.label: Deploying to Cloud Skill
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use the Cloud CLI and documented workflows for Laravel Cloud operations; verify targets, monitor every deployment, and treat environment filesystems as ephemeral.

nodes.label: Infer Conventions Skill
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Document how the application is actually written, not how it should be written; record consistent real choices and decisions, not defaults or tooling-owned patterns.

nodes.label: Dark Slate + Green Favicon Palette
nodes.rationale: #0f172a slate-900 background with #22c55e green stroke reuses Tailwind default palette tokens, keeping the mark consistent with the app's utility-class color system.

nodes.label: Rounded Square Icon Container
nodes.rationale: 32x32 viewBox with rx=8 gives an app-icon silhouette so the favicon reads as a tile in browser tabs and OS shortcuts.

nodes.label: Stacked Layers Glyph
nodes.rationale: Three stacked rhombus outlines suggest layered cartons/inventory tiers, signalling an e-commerce/logistics identity at small sizes where detail is lost.
